contract.code_identity: The deployed code in the deploy transaction record is byte-identical to the repository file at this commit.

actors.note: Throwaway Studio faucet accounts. No private key is stored in this repository.

offchain_check_of_the_same_source.note: Recorded only as a locator for the reader. The verdict below was produced inside GenVM by independent validator executions, not by this request.

payout_observation.note: The covenant balance decrease from 100 to 0 is the payout proof: the external message that carried the 100 units was delivered instead of skipped. The grantee balance nets a small decrease because transaction fees in this native unit are larger than the 100-unit payout, which matches the earlier corrected GitHub run.

method.runner_note: This is the command that produced the run. The runner no longer accepts an account file inside the repository: it rejects any path that resolves under the checkout, artifacts/ included, and the throwaway account file that run wrote there has since been deleted. A reproduction must use the GENLAYER_FUNDER_PRIVATE_KEY and GENLAYER_GRANTEE_PRIVATE_KEY environment variables, or an --account-file path outside the checkout.
method.state_reads: gen_call with transaction_hash_variant=latest-final, so no recorded state is an unaccepted one
method.write_confirmation: gen_getTransactionLifecycle must report Finalized and the transaction record is re-read afterwards, because a record fetched right after submission still carries in-flight consensus fields
method.consensus: One rotation per transaction; every write reached MAJORITY_AGREE and FINISHED_WITH_RETURN
method.no_llm: The url_marker decision compares an exact marker against a bounded body of the canonical URL; no model output is involved

related_records.stranded_preview_grants: Four earlier automated attempts left inert state on the temporary preview network because a stalled or reset Studio-dev request ended a run whose accounts held in-memory keys. That state is unrecoverable by design of this slice: the contract has no cancellation or refund path, and both the funder and grantee keys of those attempts were discarded. Recorded as a known limitation in docs/VERIFICATION.md.
